component.name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop
component.summary: Give DeepSeek eyes and ~+8% with Anchored Standard
给 DeepSeek 带上眼睛；内置锚定模式约 +8%

description.p: Official DeepSeek Harness (dsh) WebUI in a native window. Built-in ModLens vision gives text-only DeepSeek eyes: paste an image and it can read it. Built-in Anchored Standard raises DeepSeek V4 Pro about 8% over official Standard on Project2 (Ability 91 to 98/99) by anchoring the first turn on Minimal tools, then unlocking the full catalog. Credentials stay in ~/.dsh.
Tauri shell with an Apple-style title bar, bundled dsh, and on-launch updates.
